title: Automated Formal V4 trace-to-explanation structural fidelity
research_question: Does the deterministic VALIDATION V2 explanation record reproduce the exact evaluated Formal V4 trace grounding without adding a variable, number, outcome, or causal claim?

completed: Exact observation-window hash, descriptor, portfolio, authorization, execution context, ordered numeric references, and outcome are represented in a public-safe self-hashed artifact.
Formal V4-specific deterministic exact-template renderer implemented.
Independent 11-check field, text, provenance, and hash replay fidelity validator implemented.
One-path authorized runtime execution and materialization are implemented.
Versioned schemas cover trace, explanation, fidelity, run authorization, unit, and cohort documents.
Full trace, explanation, fidelity, authorization, and receipt units are durably persisted and replayed before cohort freeze.
Hash-only cohort custody requires the exact persisted full-unit receipt census.
Synthetic mutation, scope-substitution, orphan, overwrite, partial-write, and conformance tests pass without scientific execution.
requirements: Freeze schemas, renderer contract, implementation commit, tests, and artifact namespace in Commit A before evaluated scientific runtime.
Require the normal-selection Commit B receipt and explicit DEVELOPMENT_TEST1 feature authorization for scientific scope.
Persist every evaluated full unit before freezing the exact cohort bundle.

evaluated_population.population: all materialized traces emitted by the fixed VALIDATION V2 Formal V4 development runtime
evaluated_population.unit: one materialized runtime trace and its one deterministic explanation
evaluated_population.zero_observation_policy: Report NOT_OBSERVED_IN_EVALUATED_COHORT; do not inject synthetic cases into the scientific cohort.

renderer_contract.numeric_reference_rendering: References and hashes remain structured; raw values are not rendered.

fidelity_checks.expected: exact authorized horizon and seconds unit
exact numeric authority hash and ordered ten role-reference-hash bindings
exact outcome, reason, and alarm tuple
exact renderer replay and variable set limited to source and target
text numeric token multiset equals the authorized horizon token only
exact template replay and causal/root-cause flags false
two independent render, serialization, and hash runs are byte-identical

required_negative_tests: trace, window, descriptor, authorization, and execution-context hash mutation
wrong or stale portfolio and numeric authority
source, target, direction, and horizon substitution
numeric reference omission, duplication, reorder, and wrong hash
caller-authored text and unknown renderer version
label, detector, and fusion field injection
duplicate or orphan trace and explanation
current-time, random, network, provider, or LLM dependency
PILOT V1 and canonical renderer preservation regression

claim_boundary.allowed: The deterministic VALIDATION V2 explanation artifacts structurally reproduced the evaluated Formal V4 trace grounding for the observed cohort and introduced no variable, number, outcome, or causal claim outside the frozen renderer contract.

preparation_implementation.exact_remaining_blocker: Commit A plus normal-selection Commit B and explicit DEVELOPMENT_TEST1 feature authorization are required before scientific execution.
